北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾且体感偏凉，外出请戴口罩，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is hazy and feels chilly. Wear a mask and dress warmly when you go out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾且体感凉，能见度低，出行请注意安全！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy and feels cool. Low visibility, please drive safely!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天且体感凉，出门添衣，别着凉了呀！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast and feels cool. Dress warmer when you go out to avoid catching a cold!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴好，但湿度较高。体感舒适，祝您有个愉快的一天！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and humid. Feels pleasant, wishing you a lovely day!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感适中。小心昼夜温差，早晚添衣哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels mild. Watch out for temperature changes, add clothes in the morning/evening!
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感偏凉。记得多穿衣，别感冒了哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels cool. Remember to wear more layers to avoid a cold!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天且体感冷。风力稍大，出门务必多穿衣！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast and feels cold. It's a bit windy, so definitely bundle up when you go out!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感偏凉。风力稍大，请注意防寒保暖哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and feels cool. It's a bit windy, so stay warm and protected from the cold!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，能见度低。体感凉，驾车出行务必小心！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy with low visibility. Feels cool, please drive very carefully if you're out!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感偏凉。天气干燥，记得多喝水滋润！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels cool. It's dry, so remember to drink more water to stay hydrated!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感适中。出门记得带伞，以防不时之需！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and feels mild. Remember to bring an umbrella just in case!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒有雾！体感-19℃，请务必全副武装！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold and foggy! Feels like -19℃, please bundle up thoroughly!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -19℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴好，但体感寒冷。气温低，外出请注意保暖！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels very cold. Low temperature, please dress warmly when going out!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感偏凉。风力稍大，早晚注意添衣哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels cool. It's a bit windy, so add layers in the morning and evening!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴好，但体感偏凉。风力较大，小心着凉！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny but feels cool. It's quite windy, so be careful not to catch a cold!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，体感寒凉。能见度低，外出务必注意安全！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy and feels cold. Low visibility, please be very careful when you go out!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾且体感寒冷。能见度差，出行请注意安全！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy and feels cold. Poor visibility, please drive safely when traveling!
